custody_model: Dedicated first-party lending terms and disclosures establish a crypto-asset consumption-loan arrangement in which lent assets are outside segregated management and repayment depends on bitFlyer credit; customers do not have priority rights over other creditors with respect to the lent assets.
yield_source: bitFlyer publishes round-specific contractual lending fees for eligible assets lent for fixed periods. Published annualized rates are issuer product terms and are not independently verified realized returns or evidence of the operator's underlying economic performance.
risk_notes: Customer-requested mid-term cancellation is unavailable. Current first-party disclosures state that lent assets are not deposit-insured or segregated and may not be returned if bitFlyer enters insolvency proceedings. This does not establish any actual default or universal repayment outcome.
